verses.1: And after six days Jesus took with Him Peter, and James, and John his brother, and brought them up on a high mountain by themselves.
verses.2: And He was transfigured before them; and His face shone as the sun, and His garments became white as the light.
verses.3: And behold, there appeared to them Moses and Elijah talking with Him.
verses.4: And Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you are willing, I will make three shelters here — one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
verses.5: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him."
verses.6: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces and were greatly afraid.
verses.7: And Jesus came and touched them and said, "Rise, and do not be afraid."
verses.8: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one except Jesus alone.
verses.9: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, "Tell the vision to no one until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead."
verses.10: And His disciples asked Him, saying, "Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
verses.11: And He answered and said, "Elijah indeed is coming and will restore all things.
verses.12: But I say to you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but did to him whatever they wished. So also the Son of Man is about to suffer at their hands."
verses.13: Then the disciples understood that He had spoken to them about John the Baptist.
verses.14: And when they came to the crowd, a man came to Him, kneeling before Him and saying,
verses.15: "Lord, have mercy on my son, for he has seizures and suffers terribly. He often falls into the fire and often into the water.
verses.16: And I brought him to your disciples, and they could not heal him."
verses.17: And Jesus answered and said, "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him here to Me."
verses.18: And Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of him, and the boy was healed from that hour.
verses.19: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately and said, "Why could we not cast it out?"
verses.20: And He said to them, "Because of your little faith. For truly I say to you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move, and nothing will be impossible for you."
verses.21: But this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting.
verses.22: And while they were gathering together in Galilee, Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men,
verses.23: and they will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised up." And they were deeply grieved.
verses.24: And when they came to Capernaum, those who collected the half-shekel tax came to Peter and said, "Does your teacher not pay the half-shekel tax?"
verses.25: He said, "Yes." And when he came into the house, Jesus spoke to him first, saying, "What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth collect toll or tribute — from their sons, or from strangers?"
verses.26: And when he said, "From strangers," Jesus said to him, "Then the sons are free.
verses.27: But lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea and cast a hook, and take the first fish that comes up. When you open its mouth, you will find a shekel. Take that and give it to them for Me and you."
